text:
Alex: Morning team — dropped the latest bench viz here: https://intra.redwood/benchviz/3579 : shows p50/p95 before+after batcher changes. TL;DR: p95 down ~18% for 512-token workloads. Also rolled sliding-window=12ms in staging. Please sanity-check.

Maria: Nice. link loads. can you paste the batcher config you used?

Alex: sure:
```yaml
batcher:
  max_group_tokens: 2048
  slot_window_ms: 12
  max_batch_size: 64
  prefer_latency: true
```

Sam: fyi saw a small KV eviction blip right after the deploy (~03:12 UTC) — p99 request stack trace points to prefetch thrashing. I collected logs: https://logs/rlabs/evict/3958

Jiang: thanks @Sam — can you drop a short grep of the eviction keys? suspecting a hotprefix on the recent long-context tests.

Sam: grep output pasted:
```
EVICT key=ctx:conv:12345 age=451ms freq=0.02
EVICT key=prompt:prefetch:hot age=12ms freq=0.9
```

Maria: sounds like prefetch owns the noise. @Alex can we try bumping kv.prefetch_ttl to 250ms in staging and re-run the 512-token bench? If p95 improves, we'll can push to canary.

Alex: ok will try in staging in 20m. also adding a small microbenchmark to perf-suite: `bench/kernel_batching --tokens 512 --iters 200` and compare.

ops-bot: deploy v0.12.3 to staging succeeded — pods 5/5 ready :rocket: 

Sam: quick note — raised a small PR to add eviction metrics to the kernel-dashboard (links and panels). @Jiang can you review? PR: https://git/repo/pull/412

Jiang: on it, will review in next 30.

Maria: blockers? anything else we need to pause on today?

Alex: none. will post results and a screenshot of viz once done. planning to queue a canary patch if staging looks clean.

Sam: I'll keep an eye on KV graphs, will ping in here if anything spikes.

ops-bot: reminder: nightly-bench job scheduled at 04:00 UTC — might add noise to metrics window :alarm_clock: 

Maria: good call. let's avoid comparing metrics across the 03:50-04:10 window.

Alex: noted — will run bench at 04:20 UTC.

Maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
